result.title: Process-Aware Event Log Augmentation for Process Prediction under Labeled Data Scarcity
result.comment: This paper has been accepted for the International Journal of Cooperative Information Systems
result.summary: Predictive Process Monitoring (PPM) forecasts future events of ongoing business processes based on event logs. However, deep learning PPM approaches are often limited by labeled data scarcity and the low variability of real-world logs. To address this, we introduce SiamSA-PPM, a self-supervised framework combining Siamese learning with statistically grounded data augmentation. It employs novel transformation methods that leverage control-flow semantics and frequent behavioral patterns to generate realistic, semantically valid trace variants, learning generalizable prefix representations without labeled supervision. Extensive experiments on real-world event logs with a wide range of variability, incorporating exhaustive hyperparameter tuning, demonstrate the value of this process-aware augmentation. Compared to state-of-the-art baselines, SiamSA-PPM achieves competitive or superior predictive performance in both next activity and final outcome prediction tasks. An open source implementation of our method is publicly available under https://github.com/SvStraten/SiamSA-PPM-Extension..

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 SiamSA-PPM：面向预测式流程监控，用 Siamese 自监督学习结合基于控制流语义与高频行为模式的日志增强，在缺乏标注时学习可泛化的前缀表示，并用于下一活动与最终结果预测。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「语义有效的轨迹增强 + 无标注对比式前缀表示学习」这一方法线索，可能可供核查是否能迁移到 LVR 中推理轨迹的构造与训练监督（如合成语义合法的中间状态序列并对比学习其表示）。
